quotes.text: Bug 1873455 adds setBadgeTextColor/getBadgeTextColor to browser, compose, and message-display action schemas. The shared action API accepts a color array or CSS color string, converts string alpha to 0-255, rejects invalid strings, and returns opaque white when no text color override is set. The older toolbar button combines background and text declarations in badgeStyle; the unified toolbar uses --toolbar-button-badge-text-color only while badge text exists and removes it otherwise. Check both rendering paths when changing a shared extension action property. D210372 was accepted without inline requests.
